
All functions download from official sources and cache the result locally,
so the chunks below are not evaluated when the vignette is built.

```{r}
library(helvetia)

gem  <- gemeinde(stand_d = as.Date("2021-01-01"))
pop  <- pop_gemeinde(jahr_n = 2021)
geo  <- geo_gemeinde(stand_d = as.Date("2021-01-01"))
area <- areal_gemeinde(period_x = "2013/18", level_n = 17)

# aggregate the statistics before joining them to the map
pop_total <- aggregate(ch_n ~ gem_id, data = pop, FUN = sum)
map <- merge(geo, pop_total, by = "gem_id", all.x = TRUE)
plot(map["ch_n"])
```

## Time concepts

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `stand_d` | exact date of a register or geometry stand |
| `jahr_n` | statistical year |
| `period_x` | multi-year survey period, e.g. `"2013/18"` |
| `gem_stand_d` | municipality boundaries a result is reported on |

A population figure for 2021 refers to the municipalities of 31.12.2021,
the Arealstatistik 2013/18 to the boundary stand in `gem_stand_d`. Check
which municipalities match before joining:

```{r}
setdiff(unique(pop$gem_id), gem$gem_id)
```

## Sources and cache

```{r}
source_info(area)
cache_list()
```
